summary: Verified Telegraph flood-control auto-retry fix. All 3 deterministic unit tests in test_flood_retry.py pass (short flood retried, long flood not retried, non-flood re-raised). Full backend pytest suite 72/72 green. Live regression against preview URL confirmed: (1) single photo draft finalizes to status=ready with telegra.ph URL, (2) 12-slot video draft paginates and finalizes with videos_url, (3) hashtags do not appear on the Telegraph article page.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'); migrate to lifespan handlers (non-blocking).
server.py is 781 lines; consider splitting posts/media/auth routers into modules for maintainability.
_call_with_flood_retry parses 'Retry in N seconds' via string match; consider a compiled regex + max retry count cap to prevent an adversarial series of 30s waits from stalling requests indefinitely.
seed_data_creation: Live test created 2 TEST_ posts on preview and deleted them via DELETE /api/posts/{id}?delete_media=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Flood-retry fix verified. Live regression script at /app/backend/tests/live_regression.py exercises full photo+video multi-page flow against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and self-cleans; safe to rerun.
rca of the issue: Original bug: Telegraph API rate-limits page creation per-account; a single post creating multiple pages (paginated) triggered short flood windows and surfaced 'Flood control exceeded. Retry in N seconds' to the user. Fix: telegraph_service._call_with_flood_retry parses the retry-in value, sleeps N+1 seconds and retries when N <= FLOOD_MAX_WAIT (30); create_paginated_page/edit_paginated_page also add asyncio.sleep(0.7) between pages to smooth burst rate. Long flood windows re-raise and server.py _finalize_post translates the raw error into a friendly RU message. Unit tests in test_flood_retry.py deterministically validate all three paths.
